bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to transportation; providing for a Rum River Dam pedestrian bridge; transferring money to the active transportation account; appropriating money.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. TRANSFER; ACTIVE TRANSPORTATION.

The commissioner of transportation must transfer $10,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 from the general fund to the active transportation account in the special revenue fund under Minnesota Statutes, section 174.38.

Sec. 2. APPROPRIATION; RUM RIVER DAM PEDESTRIAN BRIDGE.

$10,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the active transportation account in the special revenue fund to the commissioner of transportation for the active transportation program under Minnesota Statutes, section 174.38, to provide one or more grants to the city of Anoka for design, engineering, environmental analysis, land acquisition, and construction of a pedestrian bridge over the Rum River Dam in the city of Anoka in association with Rum River Dam improvements. This appropriation is available until June 30, 2029.
additions: The commissioner of transportation must transfer $10,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 from the general fund to the active transportation account in the special revenue fund under Minnesota Statutes, section 174.38.
APPROPRIATION; RUM RIVER DAM PEDESTRIAN BRIDGE.

$10,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the active transportation account in the special revenue fund to the commissioner of transportation for the active transportation program under Minnesota Statutes, section 174.38, to provide one or more grants to the city of Anoka for design, engineering, environmental analysis, land acquisition, and construction of a pedestrian bridge over the Rum River Dam in the city of Anoka in association with Rum River Dam improvements. This appropriation is available until June 30, 2029.
